# Crosswalk — Company LinkedIn Finder

> Find a company's LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok and YouTube from its website or name, verified from the platform side. Organizations only, never people, never guesses.

## Use it
- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
- MCP tool: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/publicrecords~company-social-profile-finder/runs

## Claims you can rely on
- verified from the platform side
- confidence score and evidence per link
- organizations only, people refused
- ambiguous names return candidates
- cache hits free
- stable canonicalId
- rebrand and handle-change events
